svg.aria-label: In Codex CLI, handoff-guard.mjs runs with --host codex: it records a git baseline when a new chat starts, reads the chat’s size from token_count events, and saves the recap as a note at each turn’s end so the next chat can take over.
svg.text: Codex CLI: one chat, hook by hook
What the hooks do on Codex, run with --host codex; a grey chip marks each step that differs from Claude Code
Idle unless a tool is denied.
The recap is plain text, read
INSTALL, COMMANDS AND WHAT IT NEVER DOES
A dry run previews every change. --write copies the script and merges
codex-hooks.json into hooks.json, backing it up. You paste the recap rule
The model runs takeover, resume-here and notes; list prints the bars for
you. Notes are plain JSON in ~/.codex/handoff/, kept 72 hours, this
No network, no telemetry, no dependencies. It never edits your code, and every
mode exits 0, so a broken hook can never block Codex itself.
